description: This file contains the Persian (fa) localization for the Select2 plugin (version 4.0.6-rc.1). It defines translation strings for various user interface messages used by the select2 library.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to remove excess characters when input exceeds the maximum.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is below the minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while a search is in progress.
